verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Sift has Workflows, which it describes as a rules automation platform. It also has a sandbox for sending test events without affecting production scores, and supports backfilling historical data to improve its models. None of this documents replaying a rule against historical traffic to see what it would have blocked, flagged, or cost. The sandbox runs separately on test data, so it is not a backtest of real traffic, and historical backfill is for model training, not rule simulation.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, I can backtest a rule against my historical traffic before deploying it, seeing exactly what it would have blocked, flagged, and cost
